name: gitlab
description: GitLab workflow best practices and glab CLI usage

reviewers.title: Extra reviewers
reviewers.description: Comma-separated usernames that --bots treats as review bots, beyond the structural bot detection. Empty adds none.

ignore.title: Ignored commenters
ignore.description: Comma-separated usernames whose merge request comments the watcher never sends to the session. Approvals still reach it. Empty ignores none.

ignoreBody.title: Ignored bot comments
ignoreBody.description: A regular expression. A bot's merge request comment whose body matches it is not sent to the session, beyond the built-in chatter rules. Empty adds none.

watch.title: Watch the merge request
watch.description: Watch the current branch's merge request in interactive sessions and show its state in the prompt footer.
